description: The Little Rock District Corps of Engineers are looking for vendors that have a 350 - 400 Square Foot Modular SCIF readily available in support of USACE Critical Infrastructure Cybersecurity Mandatory Center of Expertise in Branson, MO.  If you have one readily available, please send the specs of the building to Marcus Mitchell.  Also provide the lead time it will take to have the building on site.  My email address is marcus.d.mitchell@usace.army.mil  My telephone number is 5013401253.
